needed.suggestion: Install a signalised pedestrian crossing on the right side to improve safety for pedestrians crossing at this busy intersection.
Add a pedestrian refuge island in the middle of the road to provide a safe place for pedestrians to wait when crossing at this busy intersection.
Install dropped kerbs at the crossing to improve accessibility for pedestrians with mobility aids and wheelchairs.
